channel.title: The Motley Fool UK - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Motley Fool UK (fool.co.uk)

item.title: Stock market correction: a once-in-a-decade opportunity to get rich?
item.description: Harvey Jones examines whether investors should take advantage of the current stock market correction to buy bargain-priced FTSE 100 shares.

item.title: Down 70%, is Fevertree Drinks a share to consider buying at 815p?
item.description: Fevertree reported its 2025 earnings today and the investors liked what they saw. So is this a share to consider buying while it's still down?

item.title: Are investors taking a big gamble chasing Rolls-Royce shares higher and higher?
item.description: With Rolls-Royce shares having fallen back from their peak, the temptation to see this as a buying opportunity must be strong.

item.title: How much would someone need in an ISA to target a £1,000 monthly second income?
item.description: Christopher Ruane explains how someone could use an empty Stocks and Shares ISA to target a four-figure monthly second income within a decade.

item.title: Down 25%, are Barclays shares simply too cheap to ignore?
item.description: Barclays shares have given up a chunk of their recent gains since the Middle East powder keg ignited. Should investors pile in now?

item.title: In volatile markets, could National Grid dividends be a safe haven?
item.description: National Grid offers a dividend yield well above the FTSE 100 and aims to keep growing its payout per share. Should this writer buy the share for his ISA?

item.title: Stock market correction: a once-in-a-decade chance to build big passive income?
item.description: Ben McPoland takes a closer look at a high-yield passive income stock from the FTSE 250 that investors have been buying recently.

item.title: £20,000 invested in a Stocks and Shares ISA 5 years ago could now be worth...
item.description: The last five years have been something of a roller coaster for the markets. How would £20k in a Stocks and Shares ISA have got on?

item.title: Forget the FTSE 100 and come back after summer? Here's my plan!
item.description: With the FTSE 100 moving around in a volatile way, should our writer just forget all about it for a few months and hope things will settle down?

item.title: After a 30% rally, are BP shares too expensive -- or should I consider more?
item.description: Mark Hartley breaks down the investment case for BP shares and whether the new project in Egypt is enough to drive further growth.

item.title: The stock market hasn’t crashed... yet. Don’t wait too long to prepare
item.description: Mark Hartley outlines what defines a stock market crash and provides a few tips and tricks to help UK investors better prepare.

item.title: £5,000 invested in Aviva shares 5 years ago is now worth...
item.description: Aviva shares have vastly outperformed the FTSE 100 over the last 5 years. Zaven Boyrazian explores just how much money have investors actually made?

item.title: I just discovered this REIT with a juicy 9% dividend yield
item.description: Jon Smith points out a REIT that just came on his radar due to the high yield, but comes with plenty of other factors supporting the investment case.

item.title: Stock market correction: a rare second income opportunity?
item.description: Falling share prices are pushing dividend yields higher. That makes it a good time for investors looking for chances to earn a second income.

item.title: Up 59% this year, this S&amp;P 500 stock is smashing the index!
item.description: Jon Smith points out a stock from the S&amp;P 500 that's flying right now as part of a transformation plan, but does it have the legs to keep going?
